score_breakdown.reason: USD 189.22–587.33/month versus budget 500: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 3.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 2.75/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 1/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.

alternatives.why_not: Best compatible complete plan using this option scored 54, below 60; other layers may also differ.

backend.justification: Provides a go application runtime for the web_app profile. Language familiarity and delivery complexity were compared across compatible whole plans. Selected after supporting-service compatibility and whole-plan infrastructure cost scoring. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data-flow/control exceptions.
tradeoffs: Business features, authentication and compatible database drivers must be configured; the framework alone is not the application.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

database.justification: relational persistence via Cloud SQL for MySQL.  Database drivers and host deployment were checked as a combination. Selected after supporting-service compatibility and whole-plan infrastructure cost scoring. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data-flow/control exceptions.
tradeoffs: Data model, backup policy, licensing and release/driver compatibility need explicit review.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

frontend.justification: Covers requested targets web with spa rendering. Team languages: go. Selected after supporting-service compatibility and whole-plan infrastructure cost scoring. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data-flow/control exceptions.
tradeoffs: Client accessibility, security and device behavior still require implementation and testing.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

hosting.justification: Matches managed_cloud with provider gcp; no country/region assurance was requested or inferred. Required runtimes and separate database deployment were checked. Selected after supporting-service compatibility and whole-plan infrastructure cost scoring. Explicit critical warnings identify provisional data-flow/control exceptions.
tradeoffs: No workload pricing/SLA is inferred; region, storage, backups, identity and networking require deployment review.
WebSocket clients must handle request timeouts/reconnection and cross-instance state.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Build/test/deploy with pinned dependencies, synthetic fixtures and controlled secrets; production data does not enter the build service.
tradeoffs: Source and synthetic fixtures only; production data, secrets and personal data must never be sent to external build logs. Usage above included minutes is billed.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Collect redacted metrics/logs/traces with regional retention; on cloud use a configured host-provider regional log bucket, locally use provisioned persistent storage. Deploy in the same reviewed compute/data region; explicit configuration is required.
tradeoffs: Redact sensitive values, use host-region retention/routing, and provision a durable regional log backend. No personal data in tracing baggage.
